cohort: 8844 Chinese urban women who delivered live singletons at ≥28 weeks of gestation between June 2012 and March 2013
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, preterm birth, macrosomia, and LGA in Chinese urban women.
mod_finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery in Chinese urban women.
